name: Stygiomedusa
source:
Tossed overboard and into the turbulent sea, someone... or something takes an interest in you. Pulled down into the darkest depths, you're surprised to find an unexpected pocket of light - an entire civilization on the ocean floor. You're not quite sure how you ended up here, or how to get home.

As you delve deeper into your fascinating new home, you begin to wonder how you'll possibly satisfy the strange demands of the locals who are just about as wary of you as you are of them. Growing closer is a challenge, especially once you encounter an even greater force intent on entrapping all within a maddening web...

[From [url=https://stygiomedusagames.itch.io/stygiomedusa-an-eldritch-horror-dating-sim]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你被抛下船舷、坠入汹涌翻腾的大海，却有某个人……或者说某种存在对你产生了兴趣。被一路拽入最幽暗的深海之后，你惊讶地发现那里竟藏着一片意想不到的光明之地——一座坐落于海底的完整文明。你既搞不清自己究竟是如何流落至此，也不知道该怎样重返家园。

随着你对这片迷人的新家园探索愈深，你开始犯愁自己究竟该如何满足当地居民千奇百怪的要求——毕竟他们对你的戒心，丝毫不亚于你对他们的提防。拉近彼此的距离绝非易事，尤其当你撞见一股更加深不可测的力量，正企图将所有人一并拖入令人疯狂的罗网之中……
